summary: User accidentally sent native TRX to a deposit address intended for USDT TRC-20 while using the correct TRON network and address. The transaction confirmed but the receiving platform did not automatically credit the TRX and escalated the case for manual recovery review.
user_mistake: Selected TRX instead of the intended USDT asset
prevention: Confirm the asset as well as the network and address before sending / Send a small test transaction before transferring the full amount
